heuristics.insight: Audio feedback loops on laptop hardware occur if wake chimes overlap with microphone stream opening. Always enforce >= 150ms dissipation delay before opening speech recognition sources.
Windows on ARM64 requires explicit emulation overrides for legacy x86 bundled binaries (e.g. flac-win32.exe) when upstream packages omit arm64 architecture strings.
Sub-8B parameter models require clean, direct conversational prompts without JSON or tool meta-dialogue in system prompts to prevent hallucinated code leaks.
Snapdragon X 16GB platforms operate with keep_alive: 10m and num_ctx: 8192, delivering sub-2s cached response latency while preserving unified memory efficiency.
Screen grabbing via PIL ImageGrab fails on Windows 11 ARM64 due to display driver handle virtualisation; PowerShell .NET Graphics CopyFromScreen provides stable, crash-free frame acquisition.

Feeding uncompressed 4K screen bitmaps directly to edge multimodal models creates severe latency and memory spikes; Lanczos downsampling to 1280px cuts payload by 90% while maintaining full UI element and font fidelity.
Sandboxed Python subprocess execution with a 60s timeout enables the companion to solve ad-hoc mathematical, algorithmic, and data transformations without arbitrary premature cutoff.

moondream:latest provides sub-2s visual inference on edge Snapdragon hardware with a 1.7GB footprint. First-time model hydration requires ~2.8s cold-load duration before stabilizing to instant cached inference.
Background daemons for edge AGI companions must decouple notification dispatch from blocking speech synthesis using non-blocking daemon threads to maintain instantaneous CLI responsiveness.

Browser-native Web Speech API (webkitSpeechRecognition + speechSynthesis) delivers zero-lag, driver-independent voice interaction on Windows ARM64, eliminating terminal audio driver edge-cases and acoustic feedback loops.
SQLite FTS5 implicit AND semantics fail on multi-word user prompts; tokenized OR queries with stop-word stripping preserve robust episodic recall across conversational and complex instructions.
Speech synthesis text sanitation must preserve numeric digits, restricting regex filtering strictly to bracketed citation indices like [1] or (1).
Web Speech API requires continuous mode with a 2.0s silence debounce timer to prevent premature cutoff of multi-clause spoken commands.
Llama 3.2 requires strictly alternating user/assistant turns in the prompt history; consecutive user turns trigger false refusal fallbacks (e.g. 'I can't fulfill this request').
Edge personal companions require dual-path OS agency: sandboxed Python subprocess execution for computation and direct PowerShell/CMD execution for OS operations.
